requirements.reusable_collectors: expanded_dagger_collection.py implements atomic per-episode journals, exact resume, pending-output commitment, fixed-order collection, correction certification, deterministic aggregation and read-only independent replay; run_expanded_dagger_collection.py exposes prepare, worker, worker-audit, final and final-audit stages.
requirements.three_iteration_one_modalities: Text-state, visual-state and multimodal-state iteration-one cells all reached their frozen 128-correction quota and published collection, correction-set and aggregation artifacts.
requirements.training_only_membership: Every episode, decision, correction and aggregation record has split=train and a task in the frozen 25-task BFS training order; no development or final task appears.
requirements.invalid_attempt_provenance: All 387 rejected student decisions retain the raw student output, strict parse result, trusted runtime result and invalid-operation charge. Rejected student operations never enter the trusted rollout.
requirements.expert_queries_and_state_links: Each of 384 corrections records expert_query_charge=1, the identical last-valid model input and view, full last-valid Search Memory, accepted-event count, applied rollout-event index, expert raw output, parse/runtime results and target. The expert-applied event index equals the recorded last-valid accepted-event count.
requirements.quota_stop_semantics: Each cell contains 128 corrected rejections followed by exactly one retained rejected student decision with no expert query and no applied rollout event. Unused decision quota expired in that cell.
requirements.no_invented_or_duplicated_corrections: Each modality has 128 distinct correction IDs and 128 distinct input/view identities. No quota was expanded, transferred or filled with an invented or duplicated correction.
requirements.aggregation: Each modality aggregation has exactly 512 unique record IDs: the first 384 records from the fixed original BFS membership followed by the 128 genuine corrections in collection order. The declared future update remains one epoch and 16 optimizer updates.
requirements.independent_replay: The two worker completion hooks replayed all 36 completed episodes and all 384 corrections without model calls. The CPU final job reconstructed all three aggregations, and its separate final hook repeated the replay and comparison successfully.
requirements.visual_contract: Every decision binds task context, initial state, current state and goal pages. Visual and multimodal on-policy assets use scene-only-128-unlabelled-v1; all 180 dynamically persisted scene PNGs are 128 by 128 pixels.
requirements.model_call_bounds: There are exactly 659 recorded model-call measurements, one per student decision. Maximum observed input tokens were 2298 text, 3785 visual and 4761 multimodal; maximum generated sequence length was 167, within the frozen allowances.
requirements.scheduler_and_hooks: Collection ran through the shared scheduler on physical GPUs 0 and 1 with distinct MASTER_PORT values 18800 and 18801. Latest worker terminals and worker-audit hooks returned zero; the CPU final terminal and final-audit hook also returned zero.
requirements.safe_resume_and_failure_retention: The successful text and visual cells report retained episode replay after technical recovery. Both failed attempt pairs, their logs, terminals, hook failures and GPU charges remain in the ledger; no scientific decision was discarded or regenerated.
requirements.budget: All DAgger attempts, including qualification and technical failures, consumed 2.220535196661949 GPU-hours against the unchanged 48 GPU-hour branch cap.
requirements.coverage_publication: dagger-iteration-1.json publishes complete cell and missing-task coverage. The 1.3 MiB raw dataset tree remains under the frozen outputs/expanded-study/v1/dagger/collection/iteration-1 path, while this compact tracked ledger content-addresses every collection, correction and aggregation document.
requirements.goal6_handoff: No policy update was run. Iteration two must use the corresponding iteration-one updated policy and remains open with the two-iteration requirements in #80, #81, #82 and #83.

retained_technical_failures.cause: The frozen SceneOnlyViews map omitted valid on-policy states reached after the first student decision; dynamic unlabelled scene persistence fixed the defect.
Resume replay did not advance completed sessions through their terminal next_request; exact terminal replay fixed the defect.

verification_results.standalone_final_replay: PASS: all three DAgger iteration-one correction sets independently replayed and aggregated
verification_results.direct_serialized_corpus_audit: PASS: all 659 decisions, 384 corrections and 1536 aggregation records satisfied provenance, linkage, order, uniqueness, split and quota assertions
